---
name: Documentation Improvement
about: Suggest an improvement, correction, or addition to the Limoxel documentation.
title: "[Documentation]: "
labels: ["documentation"]
assignees: []
---

# Documentation Summary

Provide a concise summary of the documentation issue or proposed improvement.

---

# Documentation Location

Specify the location of the documentation.

Examples:

- README.md
- CHANGELOG.md
- CONTRIBUTING.md
- Foundation Documentation
- Architecture Documentation
- Engineering Documentation
- Repository Structure
- API Documentation
- Other

---

# Current Content

Describe the current documentation or identify the section that requires improvement.

If possible, quote the relevant text.

---

# Proposed Improvement

Describe the proposed change.

Explain how it improves clarity, accuracy, completeness, consistency, or usability.

---

# Reason

Why is this improvement necessary?

Examples include:

- Incorrect information
- Outdated content
- Missing explanation
- Ambiguous wording
- Inconsistent terminology
- Formatting improvements
- Additional examples
- Improved developer experience

---

# Additional Context

Provide any supporting information, references, or examples that may help reviewers evaluate the proposal.

---

# Checklist

Please confirm the following before submitting.

- [ ] I have searched existing Issues and Discussions.
- [ ] I have verified that the documentation issue still exists.
- [ ] My proposal is consistent with the engineering philosophy of Limoxel.
- [ ] My proposal improves documentation without changing established engineering principles or architectural decisions.

---

# Maintainer Review

Documentation is considered a first-class engineering artifact within Limoxel.

Documentation improvements are reviewed for:

- Technical accuracy
- Engineering consistency
- Architectural alignment
- Terminology consistency
- Documentation quality
- Long-term maintainability

Documentation proposals that affect engineering principles, architecture, repository organization, or platform behavior may require corresponding implementation review.

If you are unsure whether your documentation proposal aligns with the project's long-term direction, you may contact:

**hello.limoxel@gmail.com**

before preparing substantial documentation changes.

Thank you for helping improve the engineering documentation of Limoxel.
